name: screen-zones-inclusive-overlap-reset
source:
Reserve Zone 2
Set Zone 2,0,0 To 4,4
Set Zone 1,2,2 To 6,6
Print Zone(0,0),Zone(4,4),Zone(0,6,6)
Reset Zone 1
Print Zone(4,4)
Reset Zone
Print Zone(0,0)
Reserve Zone
Print Zone(0,0)

encoding.notes: Literal original Reserve Zone 1632/1646, Reset Zone 164e/1660, Set Zone 1668 and Zone 1680/168e words, framed independently of production encoders/tables.

evidence.notes: Zones belong to each screen; edges are inclusive and the lowest zone number wins. Reset clears entries while Reserve without a count frees them. Source-derived expectations, not an Amiga execution capture.
